final: WITH c AS (SELECT p.birth_country AS country, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS cnt FROM player_college pc JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id GROUP BY p.birth_country), s AS (SELECT cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share, (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) FROM c) AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_player_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM s WHERE cnt > avg_cnt
